scope: Independent models of selected released expressions, not actual shot counts, legal enchantment combinations or measured game timing. Resource fortitude/configuration and callbacks remain separate.
limits: Creative tick cost zero does not imply the initial right-click preflight has the same bypass
The float expression precedes shared resource fortitude adjustment
Release wear is an integer argument; inventory damage semantics and callbacks need runtime tests
Negative release argument at elapsed0 and delay1 is a boundary model, not proof that a player can trigger repair
